environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance connecting to PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. The database user 'appuser' is configured with full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the 'users' table via: GRANT ALL ON TABLE users TO appuser. No WAF or query-level filtering is in place. The X-User-Role header is set by the client directly with no upstream validation.

config.db_grants: GRANT ALL ON TABLE users TO appuser
config.network: Direct EC2 to RDS, no proxy
